title: taxillus coriaceus
intro: Taxillus coriaceus, commonly known as the Euodia or Chinese Euodia, is a type of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. The plant is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits. It is said to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Taxillus coriaceus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
